name: leonin_vanguard_three_creatures_pump_ends_with_the_turn
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control three or more creatures, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and you gain 1 life.' Seat 0 controls Leonin Vanguard and two Bears: at the beginning of combat the Vanguard becomes 2/2 and seat 0 gains 1; the Vanguard attacks alone for 2. On seat 1's turn (turn 2: not seat 0's combat) it is a 1/1 again and nothing more is gained.
